text:
Connor O'Brien  [root]
Okay, last call on the checklist before we flip the upgrade feature on for beta (Private). Goal is enablement in staging today + customer beta window later this week.

Checklist doc (draft): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/PRIV/Private+Upgrade+Beta+Go-No-Go
Runbook draft: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SRE/Private+Upgrade+Runbook (still marked DRAFT)

Tracking issues:
- ENG-2314 (initiative): https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2314
- ENG-2323 (GA readiness checklist but we’re using subset for beta gate): https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2323
- ENG-2321 (telemetry/diagnostics): https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2321
- ENG-2317 (backup primitive): https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2317
- ENG-2318 (rollback hooks): https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2318
- ENG-2319 (offline bundle import): https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2319

Can folks reply with go/no-go for: prechecks, backups, rollback guardrails, telemetry + diag bundle, runbook “good enough”, and security signoff for signed artifacts.

---
Sahana Iyer
CI is green on the installer branch we’re planning to cut from (`private/1.12.0-beta.1`). Integration tests from ENG-2322 subset ran overnight.
- PASS: disk full simulation triggers rollback
- PASS: image pull fail triggers abort + rollback
- PASS: schema mismatch blocks upgrade before touching runtime

Only note: tests assume `--non-interactive` for rollback, and the prompt behavior is still behind a flag. Devon told me that’s intentional.

---
Devon Price
Yep. Current behavior:
- default is interactive prompts for rollback if you’re in a TTY
- for automation / support, we expect `--non-interactive --yes` (or `--force` for a couple edge cases)

Also: `upgrade plan` and `precheck --json` output are stable now.
PR refs:
- installer PR 418/421/433/444 are all merged into the beta branch.

---
Rafael Mendes
Runbook: I did a final pass this morning.
What’s in there:
- exact commands (`upgrade plan`, `precheck`, `upgrade apply`, `rollback`)
- what dashboards to watch
- how to pull diagnostics tarball
- common failure modes + where to look (k8s events, pod logs)

What’s still a bit thin:
- on-prem/offline bundle section is “v0” and assumes a known-good USB/import path.
But for beta (VPC customer) it’s fine.

I’ll update the runbook banner to call out VPC-only beta scope.

---
Sean Gallagher
SRE go, with one caveat: we need to be explicit that rollback is NOT always safe if migrations are forward-only.
I want that wording in:
1) the installer output (already blocks if migration metadata says forward-only)
2) runbook “rollback safety check” section
3) the beta comms to Markus / customer

Also, who’s on point for upgrade-related paging during the rehearsal? I can have Owen on backup but we should name primary.

---
Connor O'Brien
+1. Let’s make that the headline disclaimer.
Paging: propose Rafael primary for the window + me as release wrangler + Sean/Owen as escalation.

---
Aisha Bello
Dashboards/alerts are ready on staging.
Links:
- Upgrade execution dashboard: https://grafana.redwoodinference.com/d/priv-upg-exec/private-upgrade-execution
- Alerts folder: https://grafana.redwoodinference.com/alerting/list?folder=private-upgrades

For beta I tuned alerts to be less noisy:
- page on `upgrade_run_failed > 0` for that cluster
- page on step duration p95 > 20m for `backup` or `migrate`
- warn (not page) on repeated precheck failures

If we want paging routed to #oncall-private I can set that after we pick owners.

---
Allison Grant
Telemetry format check: structured logs include `upgrade_correlation_id` and `step_id`.
Diag bundle includes:
- precheck report (json)
- step timings (json)
- last 200 k8s events (namespaced)
- recent pod logs for control plane + gateway + migration job
- installer version + bundle manifest

This matches the observability standard doc for “operational workflows”. I’m good.

---
Marcus Lin
Security signoff for beta: conditional go.
Conditions:
1) Signed artifacts verification must be ON by default for offline bundle import (even if beta customer is VPC-only, we don’t want drift).
2) Audit log events for upgrade/rollback actions must be enabled in control plane (who/when/version). Confirm it’s on in the private values.
3) No secrets in diagnostics bundle. We need confirmation the bundle scrubs env vars and doesn’t `kubectl get secret -o yaml` anywhere.

If all 3 are satisfied, I’ll mark ENG-2324 as “beta approved”.

---
Devon Price
On #3: diag bundle does NOT collect secrets.
It collects:
- pod logs (already whatever the pods output, but we’re not dumping env)
- k8s events
- a sanitized `values.yaml` snapshot (we strip keys under `*.secret*`, `*.token*`, `*.password*` + known secret refs)

I can paste the scrub rules if helpful.

---
Connor O'Brien
Please paste scrub rules or link to the code so Marcus can sanity check.

---
Devon Price
Scrub logic is in `diagnostics/scrub.go` on installer.
Rules (high level):
- Redact YAML keys matching case-insensitive: `secret`, `secrets`, `token`, `password`, `passwd`, `apiKey`, `apikey`, `privateKey`, `clientSecret`.
- Redact values matching patterns: `^eyJ` (jwt-ish), `-----BEGIN`, and anything over 64 chars that’s base64-ish.
- Explicit allowlist for non-sensitive config keys (image tags, resource limits, storage class, feature flags).

We also avoid `kubectl describe secret` / `kubectl get secret` entirely.

---
Kira Thompson
Docs/runbook callout: I can update the first page with:
- “Beta scope: VPC only”
- “Rollback is best-effort and may be blocked by forward-only migrations”
- “Expected maintenance window range: 30–90m depending on DB size”

If we want, I can also add a short operator FAQ section for Support.

---
Vivek Kulkarni
Product perspective: go for beta if we’re clear on limitations.
We should NOT market “one-click rollback” in the beta messaging.
Beta success criteria for me:
- prechecks catch obvious cluster issues
- backups verified before we start applying
- rollback path works when it’s allowed
- support can triage from diag bundle without asking customer for 20 extra things

Markus: please make sure customer expectation is set on maintenance window + rollback constraints.

---
Markus Klein
Yep. Beta customer is aligned on a maintenance window + “rollback may be blocked if DB migrations are forward-only.”
I’ll send a recap after we get the final go/no-go in this thread.

Also: can I get a single link to the runbook + the exact installer version string we want them to use?

---
Connor O'Brien
Installer version target: `redwood-private-installer v1.12.0-beta.1` (bundle will be uploaded to the beta bucket once we tag).
Runbook link (will be updated today): https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/SRE/Private+Upgrade+Runbook

---
Sean Gallagher
On-call routing: please route upgrade-run-failed pages to #oncall-private and tag @Rafael @Connor.
Also, I want a 15m “go/no-go” checkpoint in the rehearsal before migration step starts.

---
Aisha Bello
I’ll update routing now.

---
incident-bot
Routing update: Alerts in folder “private-upgrades” now notify #oncall-private. Mentioning configured responders: @Rafael Mendes, @Connor O'Brien.

---
Marcus Lin
Given Devon’s note + Allison’s telemetry confirmation, I’m good on #3.
Please confirm #1/#2:
- signature verification default ON for offline bundle import
- audit log events enabled in beta values

---
Connor O'Brien
#1: yes, signature verification is default ON; import fails hard if signature invalid.
#2: audit logs enabled; control plane emits `private_upgrade_started`, `private_upgrade_completed`, `private_rollback_triggered` with actor + versions.
(Ref: redwood PR 18477 is in the beta train.)

---
Marcus Lin
Security: go for beta under the stated scope.

---
Rafael Mendes
SRE/runbook: go. I’ll patch the disclaimers + add the 15m checkpoint note.

---
Sahana Iyer
Release/CI: go. I’ll cut the tag once Connor gives the word.

---
Connor O'Brien
Cool. Consensus seems GO.
Actions before EOD:
- Rafael/Kira: update runbook disclaimers (VPC beta scope + rollback constraints + checkpoint)
- Sahana: tag `v1.12.0-beta.1` and post artifact links here
- Aisha: confirm alert routing working in staging by triggering a fake failure
- Markus: send customer recap once artifacts are ready

I’ll update ENG-2314 with status + link this thread.
:thumbsup: (reactions)

---
Kira Thompson
On it. I’ll ping when runbook is updated.

---
Aisha Bello
Will do. I can trigger a failed `precheck` alert first (non-paging) and then a forced `upgrade_run_failed` in staging to validate paging.

---
Sahana Iyer
Tagging now; will paste checksums + download links once build finishes.

---
Connor O'Brien
Thanks all. Let’s keep this thread as the single source of truth for the beta flip.
